newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Q1 GDP grew about 7 pct - gov't official.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Q1 GDP grew about 7 pct - gov't official.

text.p: Argentina's gross domestic product grew about seven percent in the first quarter of 1997, said a government official, quoting an announcement due later Wednesday by Economy Minister Roque Fernandez.
The government has previously estimated GDP growth for the whole year of at least 6.0 percent.
Fernandez's chief advisor, Carlos Rodriguez, said at a banking conference in Buenos Aires Tuesday that he would be "surprised" if first-quarter GDP growth was not eight or nine percent.

Fernandez was due to address the same conference Wednesday. The official, who spoke on condition of anonymity, said the minister would also announce government proposals to bring down bank interest rates -- something President Carlos Menem has long urged.
